rows.title: In My Life
notes: “And at the very top, In My Life, Roberta Flack covering the Beatles”
From Flack's 2012 album 'Let It Be Roberta: Roberta Flack Sings the Beatles', a full-album cover of the Beatles' songbook.

rows.title: As If You Read My Mind
Remind Me
notes: “And I'm sure that's Patrice Rushen's remind me, sort of sitting underneath is a bed sample”
1982 synth-funk cut from 'Straight from the Heart'; a heavily sampled bassline-driven groove (sampled by Mary J. Blige's 'You Remind Me').

rows.title: Down (Natasha Diggs Remix)
notes: “This is a track called Down, featuring Dames Brown... the Natasha Diggs remix of The Vision.”
2021 Defected Records remix of The Vision's 'Down' featuring Detroit soul trio Dames Brown, reworked by Natasha Diggs.
